test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements regarding the 2024 Jharkhand Assembly elections is/are INCORRECT?

1. The Indian National Congress won more than 15 seats.

2. The Jharkhand Mukti Morcha won the highest vote share.

3. Rashtriya Janata Dal won 4 seats in the Assembly.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Only 1 and 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The question pertains to the **2024 Jharkhand Assembly elections**, which are crucial for understanding the political landscape of Jharkhand.
 
• Option 1 is incorrect because the claim that the **Indian National Congress won more than 15 seats** is factually inaccurate based on the results of the 2024 Jharkhand Assembly elections.
 
• Option 2 is incorrect as it asserts that the **Jharkhand Mukti Morcha (JMM) won the highest vote share**, which is not the case. Another party might have held the highest vote share during these elections.
 
• Option 3 is correct as the **Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD)** winning 4 seats aligns with the results of the 2024 elections.
 
• The correct answer highlights that only the claims in Option 1 and Option 2 are incorrect, while Option 3 holds true.
 
• Understanding the dynamics of the 2024 Jharkhand Assembly elections is essential for evaluating the role of different parties such as the **Indian National Congress, Jharkhand Mukti Morcha, and Rashtriya Janata Dal** in shaping the state’s governance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Indian National Congress (INC)**__

 __
 
• The **Indian National Congress**, founded in **1885**, is one of the oldest political parties in India.
 
• It played a significant role in the **Indian Independence Movement** and has been a major political force post-independence.
 
• The party advocates for **secularism, democracy, and socialism**.
 
• In recent elections, its performance has varied across states, reflecting changing political dynamics.
 
 
 
• **Jharkhand Mukti Morcha (JMM)**__
 __
 
• The **JMM** was established in **1972** by **Shibu Soren** to represent the interests of tribal communities in Jharkhand.
 
• The party has been a key player in Jharkhand politics and has led the government in the state multiple times.
 
• It advocates for **tribal rights, land reforms, and sustainable development**.
 
• JMM's political strength is concentrated in tribal-dominated regions of Jharkhand.
 
 
 
• **Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD)**__
 
 
• The **RJD** was founded in **1997** by **Lalu Prasad Yadav** and primarily operates in Bihar and Jharkhand.
 
• It is known for its focus on **social justice, caste-based politics, and empowering marginalized communities**.
 
• The party has historically been strong among **Yadavs and Muslims** in the region.
 
• While the RJD primarily focuses on Bihar, it also contests elections in Jharkhand, where it has a smaller but notable presence.
